title: Connective tissue graft vs porcine collagen matrix after immediate implant placement in esthetic area: A randomized clinical trial
authors: Puisys, A., Deikuviene, J., Vindasiute-Narbute, E., Razukevicus, D., Zvirblis, T., & Linkevicius, T. (2022). Clinical implant dentistry and related research, 24(2), 141–150.
supports: Clinical study from the botiss maxgraft granules (processed human allograft) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “Within the limi ts of this trial, both treatment protocols resulted in comparable esthetic outcomes, with results showing PES >12 and stable clinical parameters after 1 year of follow-up” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
